column1:
Showers may occur at a few places in the sea areas off the coasts extending from Pottuvil to
Trincomalee via Batticaloa. Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in the sea
areas off the coast extending from Puttalam to Hambantota via Colombo and Galle during the
evening or night.
Winds will be easterly in direction. Wind speed will be (20-30) kmph.

The sea areas around the island will be slight.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
